children: RNS Number : 6411T  Churchill China PLC  07 September 2026
Change of Nominated Advisor and Sole Broker

Churchill China plc (AIM: CHH), the manufacturer of innovative performance ceramic products serving hospitality markets worldwide, is pleased to announce the appointment of Panmure Liberum as Nominated Advisor and Sole Broker for the Company with immediate effect.
Helen Tarbet / Sophie Wills / Abby Gilchrist
Panmure Liberum Limited (Nominated Advisor and Sole Broker)
Edward Thomas / John More/ Izzy Anderson
